procnotices.bid_description: MICRO2 & TuSRAP Project Manager
procnotices.contact_address: Government Building, Vaiaku
procnotices.contact_organization: Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure, Environment, Labour, Metrology and Disaster.
procnotices.notice_text:
Project: Maritime Investment in Climate Resilient Operations (P177100)

Tuvalu Safe and Resilient Aviation Project (P180674)

Reference: TV-MPWIDW-566496-CS-INDV / TV-MTECI-561102-CS-CQS

Request for Expressions of Interest

 

Country:  Tuvalu  

Project:  MICRO 2 & TuSRAP Project

Assignment Name: MICRO2 & TuSRAP Project Manager 

Grant/Credit/Loan: IDA-D9700 / IDA-E1970

Project ID: (P177100) / (P180674)

Ref: TV-MPWIDW-566496-CS-INDV / TV-MTECI-561102-CS-CQS

BACKGROUND:

  1. MICRO 2 BACKGROUND

The World Bank support the maritime sector in Tuvalu through the ongoing Maritime Investment in Climate Resilient Operations II (MICRO 2) . MICRO2 will improve climate resilience of workboat harbours in Nanumea and Nukufetau wharf project. It will also finance the resilience improvement of a new workboat harbour in Nanumaga. Prior to appraisal, financing of US$13 million equivalent under MICRO will be canceled and recommitted to MICRO2. Together with additional allocation from MICRO2 Financing, the Nanumaga harbour work will be implemented fully under MICRO2.

Project Management Support falls under component 3 of the project, that finance activities that will improve the policy, management, and regulation of a climate resilient maritime infrastructure, and provide support to address gender employment gaps and potential sexual exploitation and abuse and sexual harassment concerns related to project implementation. This sub-component will finance the provision of technical, advisory, operational, and administrative support to MPWIDW and the Project Management Unit (PMU) and supervising engineer consultancy. This would include the provision of office space, equipment, supplies, and financial auditing services.

  1. TUSRAP BACKGROUND

The World Bank support the transport sector in Tuvalu through the ongoing Tuvalu Safe and Resilient Aviation Project (TuSRAP). TuSRAP, focuses on developing a safe and resilient aviation sector building on the achievements of the Tuvalu Aviation Investment Project (TvAIP). The project development objective of TuSRAP is to improve the safety and resilience of the Recipient’s aviation sector and to ensure reliable regional air connectivity. The project supports critical investments in airport infrastructure, including runway, taxiway and apron rehabilitation (completed in 2025), installation of aviation safety and navigation equipment, climate-resilient infrastructure enhancements, ancillary terminal upgrades, and sector capacity building. In addition, the project finances institutional strengthening, development of management plans, operational procedures and training programs, safeguards obligations and project implementation support. The project is implemented by the Ministry of Transport, Energy and Tourism (MTECI) and is scheduled to close on September 30, 2027.

2. OBJECTIVE

The main objective of the assignment is to competitively hire an individual consultant for the position of MICRO II and TuSRAP Project Manager. The Consultant shall serve as Project Manager for both MICRO II and TuSRAP and shall be responsible for the overall planning, implementation oversight, coordination, monitoring, reporting, and delivery management of both projects and in line with World Bank guidelines and national priorities.

The Consultant shall be based in Tuvalu for the duration of the assignment and shall be available to undertake regular travel within Tuvalu, including to outer islands, as required. Applicants may be national or international candidates and do not need to be resident in Tuvalu at the time of application.

The Consultant will work closely with the Government of Tuvalu, in particular the Ministry of Public Works, Infrastructure, Development and Water (MPWIDW), the Ministry of Transport, Energy, Communication and Innovation (MTECI), the Ministry of Finance and Economic Development (MoFED), the Department of Marine and Port Services (DMPS), the Department of Civil Aviation (DCA) and the CPMO as well as with the World Bank task team to provide oversight and monitoring and evaluation of the project.

The position combines project management responsibilities for both MICRO II and TuSRAP. The Project Manager shall provide a single point of leadership and accountability for overall project implementation while being supported by project specialists in procurement, financial management, environmental and social risk management, monitoring and evaluation, engineering, and contract administration. The Project Manager shall ensure alignment and coordination across both transport sector projects and promote efficient use of government and project resources.

3. INVITATION

The PMU on behalf of the Implementing Agency now invites eligible individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in the position herein available within the PMU of the MICRO2 & TuSRAP project – the MICRO2 & TuSRAP Project Manager (Consultant)

Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (attach curriculum vitae with a description of experience in similar assignments, similar conditions, three references, etc).

 4. EXPERTISE REQUIREMENTS

The consultant should possess the following skills, knowledge and competencies:

  • Minimum bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, public administration, transport, infrastructure, economics, or related field. Master’s degree is desirable.
  • At least 10 years of professional experience,
  • At least 7 years in project/program management
  • Demonstrated experience managing donor-funded infrastructure projects
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple donor-funded infrastructure projects and coordinating multidisciplinary teams across government agencies.
  • Strong Contract Management experience, including works contract, claims, variations, delays and performance monitoring
  • Experience in transport/maritime and aviation infrastructure is desirable
  • Experience on a small island, remote, fragile or capacity-constrained environments highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to write operational reports for senior government officials.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills in English.
  • Cross-sectorial skills, knowledge, and ability to work with team members and stakeholders from different technical backgrounds.
  • Knowledge of and technical experience in the transport sector and experience in maritime sector will be an advantage.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and without supervision.
  • Able to travel to the outer islands of Tuvalu.

The attention of interested Consultants (including firms) is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers revised in September 2025 (the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

The link for the TOR: https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/l17554637p2fib46u4xvz/MICRO2-TuSRAP-Project_Manager-TN-LN-DRAFT_WB-Comments-1-CLEAN-1.docx?rlkey=adp8t3ana38rszlcc8hoicatd&st=2ttzf70r&dl=0

Expressions of Interest must be delivered to procurement@tusrap.org, procurement@micro2pmu.com,  and copied to ps.cpmo.nat@moftv.onmicrosoft.com PAS.CPMO.Int@moftv.onmicrosoft.com not later than 4:30pm on the 20th of August 2026 (Tuvalu Time)

Country: Republic of Mozambique

Name of Project:  Mozambique Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration (SRSEI) PROGRAM

Grant number:    IDA-E0780

Job title: Procurement Officer

Reference Number: MZ-PMU-559426-CS-INDV

The Government of Mozambique, represented by the Ministry of Transport and Logistics (MTL), has received funding from the World Bank for the Mozambique Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration (SRSEI) and intends to apply part of the resources to consulting services.

The consulting services ("the Services") involve assisting in managing and executing procurement processes for goods, works, non-consulting and consulting services to ensure speed, transparency, and cost-efficiency, in accordance with World Bank Procurement Regulations and National Procurement Procedures.

The Procurement Officer will work in close coordination with the PMU Procurement Specialist and reports to the SRSEI Project Implementation Unit (PIU) through the PIU Coordinator, who reports directly to the PCU Coordinator. All decisions should be communicated to the team accordingly.The expected duration of the project is 24 months. There will be a probationary period of 3 months from the date of signing the contract. The contract will be renewed upon satisfactory performance.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be obtained at the following Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/12WvgyeXKG_QbKVE9fN_0rHSKXuE6oBDG/view?usp=sharing

The Ministry of Transport and Logistics (MTL) now invites qualified individuals ("Consultants") to express their interest in providing the Services. Expressions of interest must include the following: (i) a CV detailing qualifications, work experience and achievements in comparable work; (ii) a cover letter, no more than two pages long, specifically addressing how the applicant fulfills each of the mandatory selection criteria listed below. . It is mandatory to specify the reference number and the job title, for the EOI to be considered. The criteria for selecting the Consultant are found in section 5 of the Terms of reference.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn  to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank's Procurement Rules for IPF Borrowers of September 2025 ("the Rules"), which sets forth the Bank's policy on conflict of interest.

Country: Guyana

Project title: Caribbean Efficient and Green-Energy Buildings Project

Contract Title: Design, Design, Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Grid-connected in lots:

                        Lot 1-Energy Efficiency Measures in 13 Government Buildings in Guyana

                       Lot 2- Renewable Energy (Solar Photovoltaic Systems) in 13 Government buildings.

 

1.         The Guyana Energy Agency (GEA) has   received financing from the Caribbean Efficient and Green-Energy Buildings Project which are administered by the World Bank and executed by the Guyana Energy Agency , and intends to use funds to eligible payments under the contract for which this Request for Proposals is issued .

2.          The GEA now invites sealed bids from eligible bidders to submit sealed bids under International Competitive Bidding (ICB) in accordance with the World Bank procurement guidelines for the Design, Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Grid-connected in lots:

            Lot 1-Energy Efficiency Measures in 13 Government Buildings in Guyana

            Lot 2- Renewable Energy (Solar Photovoltaic Systems) in 13 Government buildings

 in lump sum bases under the scope of contract package.

3.          Bidding will be conducted through the Request for Bid (RFB) procurement procedures as specified in accordance with the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” Fifth Edition, September 2023 (“Procurement Regulations”), which can be found at the following website: www.worldbank.org.

 

4.          Interested eligible bidders may obtain further information from the cashier at the Guyana Energy Agency and inspect the bidding documents during office hours. 09:00 to 16:00 hours at the address given below.

Guyana Energy Agency

295 Quamina Street, South Cummingsburg, Georgetown, Guyana

procnotices.bid_description: Administrative/Financial Assistant (Sofala)
procnotices.contact_address: Mozambique
procnotices.notice_text:
Country: Republic of Mozambique

Name of Project:  Mozambique Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration (SRSEI) PROGRAM

Grant number:    IDA-E0780

Job title: Administrative/Financial Assistant (AFA)

Reference Number: MZ-PMU-559391-CS-INDV

The Government of Mozambique, represented by the Ministry of Transport and Logistics (MTL), has received funding from the World Bank for the Mozambique Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration (SRSEI) and intends to apply part of the resources to consulting services.

The consulting services ("the Services") involve ensuring the efficient management of the administrative, financial and human resources processes of the Project Implementation Unit (PIU), ensuring transparency in the execution of the budget and reliable reporting to the Project Portfolio Coordination Unit (PCU).

The Administration and Finance Officer reports to the SRSEI Project Implementation Unit - Mozambique SOP2 (PIU) through the PIU Coordinator, who is directly reporting to the Project Portfolio Coordination Unit (PCU) Coordinator. In functional terms, it reports to the Financial Manager of PCU. The expected duration of the project is 24 months. There will be a probationary period of 3 months from the date of signing the contract. The contract will be renewed upon satisfactory performance. TheAFA will report to the Project Coordinator as leader of the PIU, which is directly subordinated to the PMU.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be obtained at the following Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AXYwS4D9wfhCV-BWkj4yA948pYBxlGmr/view?usp=sharing

The Ministry of Transport and Logistics (MTL) now invites qualified individuals ("Consultants") to express their interest in providing the Services. Expressions of interest must include the following: (i) a CV detailing qualifications, work experience and achievements in comparable work; (ii) a cover letter, no more than two pages long, specifically addressing how the applicant fulfills each of the mandatory selection criteria listed below. It is mandatory to specify the reference number and the job title, for the EOI to be considered.The criteria for selecting the Consultant are found in section 4 of the Terms of reference.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn  to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank's Procurement Rules for IPF Borrowers of September 2025 ("the Rules"), which sets forth the Bank's policy on conflict of interest.

For more information, please visit the address below during office hours from 8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.

Submissions of Interest in Portuguese and English must be sent in writing to the address below (by e-mail) by 15:00 hours on August 18, 2026, local time, CAT/UTC +2.

 

Ministry of Transport and Logistics,

Attention:Portfolio Coordinator

Avenue: Martires of Inhaminga nr 336 floor 1st

Email: procurement.ucp@mtl.gov.mz

Maputo – Mozambique

procnotices.notice_text:
REPÚBLICA DE MOÇAMBIQUE

MINISTÉRIO DAS COMUNICAÇÕES E TRANSFORMAÇÃO DIGITAL

AGÊNCIA DE TRANSFORMAÇÃO DIGITAL E INOVAÇÃO, INSTITUTO PÚBLICO

(ATDI, IP)

 

 

ANÚNCIO DE CONCURSO PÚBLICO

BENS

 

Equipamento Informático para a Plataforma de Interoperabilidade e Portal do Cidadão

(Arquitectura Cloud Soberana)

 (Processo de Concurso de Um Envelope)

 

 

Entidade: Agência de Transformação Digital e Inovação, Instituto Público (ATDI, IP)

Nome do Projeto: Projecto de Economia Digital e Governo Electrónico – EDGE

Título do Contrato:  Equipamento Informático para a Plataforma de Interoperabilidade e Portal do Cidadão

Doação nº: ID 906 – MZ (P172350)

N.º de referência do concurso: G220

 

  1. O Governo de Moçambique, recebeu um financiamento do Banco Mundial para custear o Projecto de Economia Digital e Governo Electrónico – EDGE, e pretende aplicar parte dos fundos para o pagamento ao abrigo do contrato para o fornecimento de equipamento informático para a plataforma de interoperabilidade e portal do cidadão.

 

  1. Neste contexto, a Agência de Transformação Digital e Inovação, Instituto Público, convida os Concorrentes elegíveis a apresentarem Propostas seladas para a fornecimento de equipamento informático para a plataforma de interoperabilidade e portal do cidadão.

 

  1. O processo será conduzido através de concurso nacional usando uma Solicitação de Propostas (SDP), conforme especificado no “Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de IPF” do Banco Mundial, Setembro 2023 (“Regulamento de Aquisições”), estando aberto a todos os Concorrentes elegíveis conforme definido no Regulamento de Aquisições.

 

  1. Os Concorrentes elegíveis interessados podem obter mais informações junto da Agência de Transformação Digital e Inovação, Instituto Público (ATDI, IP) – Unidade de Coordenação do Projecto EDGE -  Procurement@atdi.gov.mz  e analisar o Documento de Concurso no período das 08h:00min às 15h:30min no endereço abaixo indicado.

 

  1. As Propostas deverão ser válidas por 90 (noventa) dias, contados a partir da data de abertura das propostas.

 

  1. As propostas devem ser entregues no endereço abaixo até as 10:00H (horário local) do dia 8 de Setembro de 2026. A apresentação de Propostas por via electrónica não será permitida. Propostas tardias serão rejeitadas. As Propostas serão abertas publicamente na presença dos representantes designados pelos Concorrentes e de qualquer pessoa que decida participar, no mesmo endereço às 10:00H (horário local) do dia 8 de Setembro de 2026.

 

  1. Todas as Propostas devem ser acompanhadas de uma Garantia de Proposta no valor de 2.500.000,00 Meticais com a validade de 118 dias, contados a partir da data de abertura das propostas.

 

  1. Chama-se a atenção para o Regulamento de Aquisições que exige que o Mutuário divulgue informações sobre a propriedade efectiva do concorrente seleccionado, como parte do Anúncio de Adjudicação de Contrato, utilizando o Formulário de Divulgação da Propriedade Efectiva, tal como incluído no Documento de Concurso.

procnotices.notice_text:
APPEL A CANDIDATURES

Assistant(e) en Programmation et Suivi-Evaluation

AMI N° : 563391/26/AMI/UNGP/MIONJO

1. Le Gouvernement de la République de Madagascar a reçu un financement de la Banque mondiale pour couvrir le coût du Projet soutien aux moyens de subsistance résilients dans le Sud de Madagascar « MIONJO » et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ce fonds à des services de consultant.

2. Les services de consultant (« les Services ») viseront à assister le Responsable de la Programmation et du Suivi-Evaluation (RPSE) dans la mise en place du système de suivi-évaluation du Projet et dans l’analyse des résultats des activités du Projet, en vue d’appuyer les parties prenantes dans l’identification et les modalités de mise en œuvre des activités à réaliser durant le Projet.

3. Les Termes de Référence (TDR) pour la mission sont disponibles sur le site internet suivant : https://mionjo.mg ou sur demande à adresser à procurement@mionjo.mg.

4. L'Unité Nationale de Gestion du Projet (UNGP) MIONJO invite dès à présent les consultants admissibles (« Consultants ») à faire part de leur intérêt à fournir les Services. Les Consultants intéressés doivent fournir des informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et l’expérience pertinente pour exécuter les Services. Les critères de sélection sont les suivants :

Qualifications et expériences :

  • Titulaire d’un Diplôme de Grande école ou d’Université (de niveau minimum Bacc +3) en Gestion, Economie, Droit, Sociologie, Développement local, informatique ou dans des domaines associés ;
  • Au moins trois (03) ans d’expérience en programmation et suivi-évaluation de projets de développement impliquant les parties prenantes et comprenant la conception de systèmes de suivi-évaluation et l'utilisation d’indicateurs de performance ;
  • Expérience probante dans la formulation de plans d'actions ;
  • Maitrise de logiciel(s) et d’outils de collectes et de gestion de données ainsi que de SIG notamment du logiciel Excel avancé dont la maitrise est exigée ainsi que la capacité de traitement et d’analyse des données
  • Notion avancée sur les NTIC utilisées sur le Suivi et évaluation
  • Parfaite maîtrise de la langue française (écrite et orale) ;
  • Connaissance du contexte socio-économique des régions d’intervention est un atout ;
  • Connaissance de la langue anglaise (écrite et orale) est un atout ;
  • Expériences réussies dans des projets de développement financés par des bailleurs de fonds internationaux est un atout ;
  • Connaissance des dialectes locaux est un atout ;
  • Maîtrise des domaines de la Décentralisation, du Développement local et de la Gouvernance locale est également un atout.

Qualités :

  • Rigueur et intégrité ;
  • Capacités d’anticipation, d’observation, d’analyse, de synthèse, de rédaction et de communication;
  • Aisance relationnelle ;
  • Proactivité ;
  • Méthodique ;
  • Aptitude à travailler sous pression ;
  • Disponibilité à descendre sur terrain y compris dans des zones rurales reculées.

Les candidats qualifiés seront convoqués à un entretien et/ou à un test écrit.

5. L’attention des Consultants intéressés est attirée sur la Section III, paragraphes, 3.14, 3.16 et 3.17 du « Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs de FPI » de la Banque mondiale, Septième Edition Septembre 2025 (« Règlement de Passation des Marchés »), qui énonce la politique de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflits d’intérêts.  En outre, veuillez-vous reporter aux informations spécifiques suivantes sur les conflits d’intérêts liés à cette mission : « Le Consultant qui a une relation professionnelle ou familiale étroite avec tout cadre de l’Emprunteur, de l’organisme d’exécution du projet, d’un bénéficiaire d’une fraction du financement de la Banque ou de toute autre partie représentant l’Emprunteur ou agissant en son nom qui participe directement ou indirectement à tout segment : (i) de la préparation des Termes de référence de la mission ; (ii) du processus de sélection pour le contrat ; ou (iii) de la supervision du contrat, ne peut être attributaire d’un contrat, sauf si le conflit résultant de ladite relation a été réglé d’une manière que la Banque juge satisfaisante tout au long du processus de sélection et de l’exécution du contrat »..

6. Un Consultant sera sélectionné conformément aux dispositions décrites dans le Règlement de Passation des Marchés.

7. Des informations supplémentaires peuvent être obtenues à l’adresse ci-dessous pendant les heures de bureau de 09h00 à 17h00, heures locales.

8. Les manifestations d’intérêt contenant (i) une lettre de motivation avec prétention salariale rédigée en français, (ii) un CV détaillé mise à jour (modèle en annexe aux TDRs) et (iii) les copies des diplômes et le Certificats prouvant les expériences professionnelles, seront adressées au Coordonnateur du Projet MIONJO et envoyées à l’adresse ci-dessous (en personne, par la poste, ou par courriel) au plus tard le 23 août 2026.

 

Adresse : Lot II A 105 G Nanisana Iadiambola, Antananarivo 101

Courriel : procurement@mionjo.mg et rpm@mionjo.mg

Et portant la mention « AMI N° 563391/26/AMI/UNGP/MIONJO – Assistant en Programme et suivi-évaluation»

Antananarivo le, 05 août 2026

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REOI)

Cambodia

Skills For Better Jobs Project

IDA Credit No.: 75480-KH

 

Assignment Title: National Environment and social Consultant

Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): SDF-CS-11-1

 

The Royal Government of Cambodia (RGC) through Skills Development Fund as an implementation agency (IA) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Skills for Better Jobs Project (SBJ) and intends to apply to any part of the proceeds for consulting services.

 

The Objective of the assignment is expected to provide professional and expert support in the area of environment and social to the WB SDF PIU of MEF to ensure the successful and timely implementation and completion of SDF project’s social and environment related activities. The selected consultant shall at all times observe the highest standard of professional ethics and integrity and promote a results-oriented approach in the area of his/her responsibilities and accountability.

The consulting services (‘’the services’’) duration is 84 days on intermittent basis with the working period, counting from the contract start date.

 

The Skills Development Fund now invites eligible individual  consultants to indicate their interest in providing the service. Interest Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The evaluation criteria are:

  1. At least a bachelor’s degree in in Environment, Environmental Economics or relevant field; with at least 8 years of general experience;
  2. At least 5 years’ experience of relevant professional experience in environmental and social safeguard, Occupational Health and Safety, related TVET projects funded by the ADB, AFD, World Bank or other major donors in Cambodia;
  3. Good management skills including ability to provide strategic leadership and technical oversight and ability to work under minimum supervision
  4. At least 1 project of proven experience in developing Environmental and Social training materials and delivering related training courses to multi-stakeholders
  5. At least 1 project demonstrating strong facilitation skills in conducting consultative meetings with relevant stakeholders, especially related to gender and social inclusion; and 
  6. Good in written and spoken communication, interpersonal and report writing skills in both English and Khmer

 

The detail Term of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be found at the link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xjGPkawfy8MfN9ivnWD62gLjKsKmni_D/view?usp=sharing

 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers”, Seventh Edition, September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

 

A consultant will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

 

Further information can be addressed through the email: h.panhapich@sdfcambodia.org

Expressions of interest must be delivered by e-mail as below by 19 August 2026 at 17:00 local time.

procnotices.project_name: Inclusive Development through Electricity Access
procnotices.bid_description: Etude de renforcement des postes de Lomé Aflao, Lomé Port et Momé Hagou en vue de leur numérisation
procnotices.contact_address:
426 Avenue MAMA Fousseni BP42 
Lomé TOGO
procnotices.notice_text:
MINISTERE DE L’ECONOMIE ET DE LA VEILLE STRATEGIQUE

--------------------

MINISTERE DELEGUE CHARGE DE L’ENERGIE ET DES RESSOURCES MINIERES

------------

Projet de développement inclusif à travers l'accès à l'électricité (IDEA) au Togo

 

AVIS D’APPEL A MANIFESTATION D’INTERET

(SERVICES DE CONSULTANT – SELECTION DE CABINET)

Référence STEP : C-38

RECRUTEMENT D’UN CABINET POUR L’ETUDE ET CONCEPTION POUR LA MODERNISATION DES SYSTEMES DE CONTROLE COMMANDE ET DE PROTECTION DES POSTES HTB/HTA DE LOME AFLAO, LOME PORT ET MOME HAGOU

AMI N° 003/MEVS/MDERM/CAB/PRMP/IDEA/2026

  1. Le Gouvernement de la République togolaise a reçu un Financement de l’Association Internationale de Développement (IDA), pour financer le coût du Projet de développement inclusif à travers l'accès à l'électricité (IDEA) au Togo et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ce crédit pour effectuer les paiements au titre du contrat de services consultants relatif au recrutement d'un cabinet pour l’étude et la conception pour la modernisation des systèmes de contrôle commande et de protection des postes HTB/HTA de Lomé Aflao, Lomé Port et Momé Hagou.

 

  1. Objectif général de la mission

La mission vise à faire l’état descriptif des postes Haute Tension de Lomé Aflao, de Lomé-Port et de Momé Hagou tout en mettant en exergue les insuffisances du système actuel d’exploitation et proposer une nouvelle architecture de contrôle commande numérique avec une mise à niveau des systèmes de protection sur la base des calculs nécessaires dans le domaine.

  1. Objectifs spécifiques
  • Conduire une étude diagnostique et descriptive du système d’exploitation des postes source HTB/HTA de Lomé Aflao, de Lomé-Port et de Momé Hagou (Etat des lieux de l’exploitation du poste, en ressortant les limites de l’exploitation actuelle de ces postes assorti d’un plan d’action de mise à niveau suivant les standards internationaux en la matière sur la base de l’analyse approfondie des données disponibles à savoir  : cahiers de quarts, tableaux de bords, historique de pannes, évènements d’exploitation majeurs, incidents récurrents, etc.) ; 
  • Faire l’étude diagnostique susmentionnée et effectuer une étude complémentaire aboutissant sur un plan de protection permettant de garantir la sélectivité requise entre les équipements de protections numériques des postes de la CEET et ceux des postes de Lomé Aflao, de Lomé-Port et de Momé Hagou en harmonie avec les installations. Le plan de protection proposé devra s’appuyer sur les normes et les standards de la CEB ; 
  • Elaborer l’architecture du nouveau système de contrôle commande numérique, comprenant sans être limitatif, les fonctions à implémenter (commande, signalisation, télémesure, et à mettre à niveau, historicisation, etc.), assortie d’un détail estimatif et quantitatif du matériel requis et des délais estimatifs de réalisation ;
  • Elaborer une table d’échanges (liste des signaux) à échanger entre les différents postes et le Dispatching :
  • Proposer un plan de formation (transfert de compétences) adéquat du personnel de l’exploitation et de maintenance desdits postes.

 

  1. PROFIL DU CABINET

La consultant devra être un cabinet qualifié et ayant les capacités techniques requises de prise en charge complète de la mission qui lui sera confiée avec des expériences avérées dans le domaine du transport et distribution de l’énergie électrique. Il doit justifier d'une expérience d’au moins dix (10) ans dans la réalisation des études de cette nature.

Le consultant doit avoir réalisé au moins cinq (05) missions de réalisation des postes HTB en Afrique dans les 10 dernières années, y compris sous financement de la Banque Mondiale. Le consultant devra disposer des ressources humaines et matérielles nécessaires à l'accomplissement de la mission.

  • Un Spécialiste des systèmes de production transport et distribution de l’énergie électrique, chef de mission, de niveau universitaire (BAC+5) minimum et ayant au moins quinze (15) ans d’expérience professionnelle dans la réalisation des Etudes de nature similaire.  Il doit avoir, entre autres, réalisé ou participé à trois (03) missions d’élaboration des plans de protection et de contrôle commande numérique des postes HTB et HTA.

Le Chef de mission devra avoir de l'expérience dans les pays en voie de développement. Avoir travaillé directement en Afrique et/ou dans le secteur de l'énergie serait considéré comme un avantage.

  • Un Expert en Système de protection des postes électriques et lignes haute tension de niveau universitaire (BAC+5). Il doit justifier d’une expérience d’au moins cinq (5) ans dans la conduite de la réalisation des études de calcul des protections des HTB et HTA.
  • Un (01) ingénieur en SCADA-DMS ou informatique de niveau universitaire (BAC+5) et ayant au moins dix (10) ans d’expérience dans les travaux d’implémentation des systèmes de contrôle commande numérique dans les postes électriques.
  1. Durée de la mission

Proje Ad                : Türkiye'de Depremden Etkilenen llerde Tarm Sektörünün yiletirilmesi Projesi (TARDP)

Görev Bal         :  Ortak Makine Parklarnn Kurulmas Kapsamnda Desteklenecek Faaliyetlere likin Danmanlk Hizmet Alm

Referans Numaras : 1.2.TRGM. CS.01

 

1. Türkiye Cumhuriyeti, Tarm ve Orman Bakanl araclyla, Türkiye'de Depremden Etkilenen llerde Tarm Sektörünün yiletirilmesi Projesi'nin (TARDP) maliyetleri için Dünya Bankas'ndan finansman alm olup, finansmann bir ksmn bu davette belirtilen Ortak Makine Parklarnn Kurulmas Kapsamnda Desteklenecek Faaliyetlere likin Danmanlk Hizmet Alm (Danmanlk) için kullanmay planlamaktadr.

2. Danmanlk projenin Dünya Bankas politika ve operasyonel gereklilikleri ile Proje Deerlendirme Belgesi ve Proje Uygulama Klavuzunda yer alan hükümlere tam uyumlu ekilde yürütülmesini salamak amacyla; depremden etkilenen illerde tarmsal amaçl örgütlere ortak makine parklarnn kurulmasna, ortak makine parklarnn teknik, kurumsal, finansal, hukuki ve operasyonel çerçevesinin gelitirilmesi, iletme modelinin oluturulmas, kapasite gelitirme faaliyetlerinin planlanmas, hibe çars ve uygulama dokümanlarnn hazrlanmas, ortak makine park konsept tasarmlarnn gelitirilmesi, dijital takip sistemi için yazlm gereksinimlerinin belirlenmesi, kullanm klavuzlarnn hazrlanmas ve proje süresince teknik danmanlk hizmetlerinin sunulmasn kapsamaktadr. Söz konusu hizmet almnn süresi 52 (elliiki) ay olarak planlanmaktadr.

3. Ayrntl i tanm (TOR) aadaki web sitelerinde bulunmaktadr:

https://www.tarimorman.gov.tr/trgm

https://tardip.tarimorman.gov.tr/Duyuru/DuyuruListe

4. T.C. Tarm ve Orman Bakanl Tarm Reformu Genel Müdürlüü, uygun Danmanlk için ad geçen hizmeti salamaya yönelik olarak ilgi bildiriminde bulunmaya davet etmektedir. Danmanlk için istenen deneyime ve niteliklere sahip olduklarn gösteren bilgi ve belgeleri sunmaldr.

5. Danman, görevi tek bana yerine getirebilecek yeterli nitelik ve deneyime sahip olduunu deerlendiriyorsa, ilgi bildirimini kendi adna sunabilir.

6. Danman niteliklerini artrmak için ortak giriim kurabilir. Danmanlk bavurusunda, kuracaklar birlikteliin yapsn ve ortaklarn ve görevlerini açk bir biçimde belirtmelidir. Ortak Giriim (yani, ortak giriimin tüm üyeleri mütereken ve müteselsilen sorumlu olacaktr) eklinde olabilir. Bir ortaklk durumunda, Danman ilgi bildiriminin sunumunda (a) ortaklk kurma gerekçesini ve (b) Ortak Giriimin her bir üyesinin görevi yerine getirmedeki beklenen rolünü ve ilgili niteliklerini açklamaldr, böylece ortak giriim gerekçelendirmelidir. Yukardaki açklamann ilgi bildiriminde salanmamas, ortakln göreve ksa listeye alnmama riskini tayabilir. Ortak Giriim olmas halinde, Ortak Giriimin tüm ortaklar birlikte deerlendirilecek ve ihalenin verilmesi durumunda sözlemeyi birlikte imzalayacaklar ve dareye kar mütereken ve müteselsilsen sorumlu olacaklardr.

7. Seçim kriterleri aadaki gibidir ve Danman görevle ilgili özel deneyimi en önemli öneme sahip olarak deerlendirilecektir:

(i) Danmann Genel Deneyimi:

lgi beyannda bulunacaklarn son 10 yl içerisinde gerçekletirilen ve i tanm ile benzer nitelikteki danmanlk hizmetlerine ilikin deneyimler deerlendirilecektir.

(ii) Danman görevle ilgili benzer sözlemeler kapsamnda benzer hizmetler sunmadaki Özel Deneyimi:

Son 10 ylda boyut benzerlii ve karmaklk açsndan gerekli hizmetlere yönelik teknik destek konusunda aadaki alanlardan bir veya birkaçnda baarl ekilde tamamlanm danmanlk hizmeti deneyimine sahip olmas beklenmektedir:

  • Tarmsal amaçl örgütler, kooperatifler, üretici birlikleri, sulama birlikleri, üretici örgütleri veya benzeri kurulularn kurumsal kapasitesinin gelitirilmesi, organizasyonel yaplanmas ve yönetiim sistemlerinin güçlendirilmesi,
  • Tarm ve krsal kalknma sektörlerinde fizibilite çalmalar, ihtiyaç analizleri, strateji gelitirme, i plan hazrlanmas, operasyonel süreç tasarm, i aklarnn oluturulmas, kurumsal yap analizleri ve uygulama yol haritalarnn hazrlanmasna yönelik danmanlk hizmetleri,
  • Eitim ihtiyaç analizi, eitim müfredat gelitirilmesi, kapasite gelitirme programlar, yaym faaliyetleri, bilgi transferi ve teknik destek mekanizmalarnn tasarm ve uygulanmasna yönelik danmanlk hizmetleri,
  • Tarmsal bilgi sistemleri, dijital sistemler, karar destek sistemleri, veri yönetimi sistemleri, izleme ve deerlendirme sistemleri, dijital dönüüm projeleri veya benzeri bilgi teknolojileri uygulamalarna yönelik danmanlk hizmetleri,
  • Dünya Bankas, Avrupa Birlii, IFAD, FAO, UNDP veya benzeri ulusal ve uluslararas kurulular tarafndan finanse edilen tarm, krsal kalknma, kurumsal kapasite gelitirme veya dijital dönüüm projeleri kapsamnda yürütülen danmanlk hizmetleri.

8. Yukardaki seçim kriterlerini karlamadaki yeterliliklerini ve deneyimlerini göstermek için Danmanlarn en azndan aada listelenen destekleyici belgeleri sunmalar beklenmektedir.

Ortak giriim olarak yaplan bavurular birlikte deerlendirilecek ve ortaklarn deneyimleri birletirilerek dikkate alnacaktr.

Danman yalnzca kendi yeterliliklerini ve deneyimlerini kullanabilir. Yan ve/veya karde irketlerinin veya çalanlarnn yeterliliklerini ve deneyimlerini kullanamaz.

  • Danmann bulunduu ülkenin ilgili resmi makam tarafndan verilmi kurulu/ticaret/sicil belgeleri
  • Danmann temel i alanlarn içeren tantm dosyalar / broürleri

Benzer sözlemeler hakknda bilgi salamak için Benzer Sözlemeler Bilgi Formu (EK 2). Bu, sözlemenin adn ve referans numarasn, i kapsamnn ksa açklamasn, sözleme tutarn, sözleme süresini, müterinin adn ve görevlendirme ülkesini ve danmann sözlemedeki rolünü içermelidir. Tamamlanm sözlemelerin Müterilerinin tamamlama sertifikalarnn/referanslarnn kopyalarnn lgi Bildirimi ile birlikte sunulmas gerekmektedir.

9. lgilenen Danmanlarn, Dünya Bankas'nn Eylül 2023 tarihli versiyonu "Dünya Bankas IPF Borçlular için Satn Alma Düzenlemeleri - Yatrm Projesi Finansmannda Satn Alma Tedarik, Yapm leri, Danmanlk D Hizmetler ve Danmanlk Hizmetleri" (Satn alma Düzenlemeleri)'ndeki "menfaat çatmasna" ait politikasnn açkland 3.14 - 3.17 numaral paragraflarna dikkati çekilmektedir.

10. Danman seçimi, Satn alma Klavuzu'nda belirtilen Danmann Niteliklerine Dayal Seçim Yöntemi (CQS) yöntemine uygun olarak yaplacaktr.

11. Daha fazla bilgi aadaki adresten ahsen mesai saatleri içerisinde 09:00 - 17:00 arasnda alnabilir.

12. Türkçe olarak hazrlanacak ilgi bildirimleri, kapal bir zarf içinde ve bir üst yaz ile birlikte en geç 21/08/2026 günü saat 16:00'e kadar aadaki adrese (ahsen, posta veya kurye ile) teslim edilmelidir. procnotices.contact_address: Mozambique
procnotices.notice_text:
Country: Republic of Mozambique

Name of Project:  Mozambique Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration (SRSEI) PROGRAM

Grant number:    IDA-E0780

Job title: HEALTH AND SAFETY SPECIALIST

Reference Number: MZ-PMU-561482-CS-INDV (Sofala)

                                    MZ-PMU-559419-CS-INDV (Zambezia)

The Government of Mozambique, represented by the Ministry of Transport and Logistics (MTL), has received funding from the World Bank for the Mozambique Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration (SRSEI) and intends to apply part of the resources to hire individual consultancy services for the Health & Safety, one for Sofala province and another for Zambezia province..

The consulting services ("the Services") involve serving as the focal point of all Health and Safety risk management of the Project. The individual will ensure Project implementation complies with the World Bank Health and Safety Standards under the ESF, on assessment and management of project Health and Safety risks; labour and working conditions; community health and safety and stakeholder engagement and information disclosure.

The specific tasks will be undertaken in close coordination with PIU Coordinator, UCP/PMU, ANE, IP, Local governments, the Private sector, NGO’s and Community-based organisations staff responsible for the implementation of the Project activities. The expected duration of the project is 24 months. There will be a probationary period of 3 months from the date of signing the contract. The contract will be renewed upon satisfactory performance. The Health and Safety Specialist will report to the Project Coordinator as leader of the PIU, which is directly subordinated to the PMU.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be obtained at the following Link:

 https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HY6T8_Wt6SVlS41SnmkPJ7UN1J9fpNyj/view?usp=sharing

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1y4K7-pa6DUYfJrmh1lPDMgIMoR_pYOU7/view?usp=sharing

The Ministry of Transport and Logistics (MTL) now invites qualified individuals ("Consultants") to express their interest in providing the Services. Expressions of interest must include the following: (i) a CV detailing qualifications, work experience and achievements in comparable work; (ii) a cover letter, no more than two pages long, specifically addressing how the applicant fulfills each of the mandatory selection criteria. It is mandatory to specify the reference number and the job title, for the EOI to be considered.The criteria for selecting the Consultant are found in section 5 of the Terms of reference.

The Applicant must specify the location of Preference (MZ-PMU-561482-CS-INDV Sofala or MZ-PMU-559419-CS-INDV Zambezia)

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn  to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank's Procurement Rules for IPF Borrowers of September 2025 ("the Rules"), which sets forth the Bank's policy on conflict of interest.

For more information, please visit the address below during office hours from 8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.

Submissions of Interest in Portuguese and English must be sent in writing to the address below (by e-mail) by 15:00 hours on August 20, 2026, local time, CAT/UTC +2.

 

Ministry of Transport and Logistics,

Attention:Portfolio Coordinator

Avenue: Martires of Inhaminga nr 336, floor 1st

Email: procurement.ucp@mtl.gov.mz

Maputo – Mozambique

UNION DES COMORES

PROJET DE RENFORCEMENT DE L’ÉDUCATION POUR AMÉLIORER LES RÉSULTATS EN MATIÈRE DE CAPITAL HUMAIN (P507220)

****************

UNITE DE GESTION DE PROJET (UGP- PFSS-RRC/PREMCH)

AVIS D’APPEL A CANDIDATURE POUR LE RECRUTEMENT D’UN (E) CONSULTANT(E) INTERNATIONAL(E) — EXPERT(E) EN ÉVALUATION DES APPRENTISSAGES (EGRA/EGMA)

Date de l’avis : 15 Juillet 2026

Financement Projet N° P507220

Don N°E4100-KM

Contexte

D’une manière générale, l'Union des Comores à travers le Ministère de l’Education Nationale, de l’Enseignement, de la Recherche Scientifique, de la Formation et de l’Insertion Professionnelle s’associe et participe à l’Approche Programmatique Multiphase (APM) pour promouvoir des méthodes innovantes pour favoriser l’apprentissage en Afrique de l’est et australe. L’APM proposée, intitulée « Advancing Innovative Methods to Promote Learning » (AIM4Learning) ou Favoriser des méthodes innovantes pour promouvoir l’apprentissage, intègre des approches résolument nouvelles pour offrir une meilleure éducation aux élèves.

Cependant, l’Union des Comores a subi ces dernières années des chocs et des perturbations qui ont fortement impacté le système éducatif du pays, accentué les pertes d’apprentissages, les profondes inégalités scolaires et les risques d’exclusion scolaire des groupes les plus vulnérables. Il est nécessaire de rétablir et sauvegarder l’éducation en tant que droit fondamental, vecteur de développement, facteur de réduction de la pauvreté et levier puissant pour la paix, la résilience aux changements climatiques et au développement durable.

C’est ainsi que le Gouvernement comorien a obtenu un Don de l’Association International de Développement (IDA) et du Fonds du Partenariat mondial pour l’éducation équivalent à 23,7 millions de dollars pour répondre aux besoins du pays en matière d’amélioration et du renforcement de l’éducation pour l’amélioration des Résultats en Matière de Capital Humain aux Comores.

Il est prévu qu’une partie des sommes accordées au titre de ce Don sera utilisée pour effectuer le paiement à titre du contrat portant « Recrutement d’un (e) consultant(e) international(e) — expert(e) en évaluation des apprentissages (EGRA/EGMA) ».

Le Consultant sera recruté Conformément au « Règlement de Passation des Marchés dans le Cadre du Financement de Projets d’investissements (FPI) Fournitures, Travaux, Services Autres que des Services de Consultants et Services de Consultants », 7ème Edition - Septembre 2026.

La méthode de sélection est la « Sélection de Consultants Individuels (SCI) ».

Profil du/de la consultant(e)

Formation

Titulaire au minimum d'un Master (idéalement doctorat ou équivalent) dans un domaine pertinent : sciences de l'éducation, psychologie cognitive, linguistique appliquée, statistiques appliquées à l'éducation, économie de l'éducation ou discipline connexe.

Expérience professionnelle

  • Au moins 8 années d'expérience dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et l'analyse d'évaluations des apprentissages à grande échelle
  • Expérience avérée et directe des évaluations EGRA et/ou EGMA — conception ou révision des instruments, formation des évaluateurs, analyse des données, production de rapports — fortement valorisée
  • Expérience en évaluations longitudinales ou de suivi (mesure des progrès dans le temps, assurance de comparabilité) constituera un atout majeur
  • Expérience dans l'analyse des problèmes de qualité de données d'enquête (valeurs aberrantes, non-réponses, synchronisation CAPI) et des procédures d'apurement
  • Expérience de travail dans des contextes de pays à faible revenu ou à revenu intermédiaire, de préférence en Afrique subsaharienne ou dans l'océan Indien
  • Connaissance du contexte éducatif des Comores ou expérience antérieure dans le pays constituera un atout significatif.

Dossier de candidature

Les candidat(e)s intéressé(e)s sont invité(e)s à soumettre un dossier comprenant :

  • Un curriculum vitae détaillé mettant en évidence l'expérience en évaluations EGRA/EGMA et en évaluations longitudinales
  • Une note méthodologique (5 pages maximum) présentant : la compréhension de la mission et de ses enjeux spécifiques (notamment la dimension comparative), l'approche proposée pour la revue des instruments existants, la stratégie d'analyse des options de mise en œuvre, et un plan de travail préliminaire
  • Des exemples de travaux similaires réalisés (rapports d'évaluations EGRA/EGMA, analyses comparatives, le cas échéant)
  • Une proposition financière détaillée (honoraires journaliers et budget total estimatif pour les déplacements et les missions terrain)
  • Les coordonnées de deux références professionnelles pouvant attester de l'expérience en évaluations des apprentissages.

Les dossiers de candidatures portant la mention suivante peuvent être déposées au Secrétariat de la Coordination nationale à l’adresse mentionnée ci-dessous au plus tard le Jeudi 30 Juillet 2026 à 15 heures 30 (heure locale) avec la mention suivante :

« Recrutement d’un (e) consultant(e) international(e) — expert(e) en évaluation des apprentissages (EGRA/EGMA) ».

NB : Le dépôt en ligne n’est pas autorisé

Pour toutes informations complémentaires, veuillez consulter les Termes de Références (TDR) dans le site Web : pfss-comores.org/ www.pfss-comores.org

  • Les coordonnées de deux références professionnelles pouvant attester de l'expérience en évaluations des apprentissages.

Les dossiers de candidatures portant la mention suivante peuvent être déposées au Secrétariat de la Coordination nationale à l’adresse mentionnée ci-dessous au plus tard le lundi 17 Août 2026 à 15 heures 30 (heure locale) avec la mention suivante :

« Recrutement d’un (e) consultant(e) international(e) — expert(e) en évaluation des apprentissages (EGRA/EGMA) ».

NB : Le dépôt en ligne est autorisé et il peut être envoyé au Coordinateur : cn@pfss-comores.org et copie : rpm@ pfss-comores.org

GENERAL PROCUREMENT NOTICE

 

INDONESIA

INDONESIAN MASS TRANSIT PROJECT

GENERAL PROCUREMENT NOTICE

Loan No. IBRD 9340-ID

Project ID No. P169548

 

The Government of Indonesia has received financing in the amount of US$223 million equivalent from the World Bank toward the cost of the Indonesian Mass Transit Project (IMTP), and it intends to apply part of the proceeds to payments for goods, works, consulting services and non-consulting services to be procured under this project.

The Ministry of Transport (MoT) as the Implementing Agency will implement the Indonesia Mass Transit Project (MASTRAN) with a view to addressing the critical mobility needs of Indonesian cities and improving livability. The Project will cover institutional and capacity development and assistance with the development of a national program of assistance for mass transit in Indonesian cities, and investments in road-based mass transit systems in Bandung Basin Metropolitan Area (BBMA) and Mebidang (Kota Medan, Kota Binjai, Deli Serdang Regency).

The proposed MASTRAN will be the first phase of the national assistance program. It will help to finalize the program design, develop a pipeline of projects for the program, build institutional capacity and, through the implementation of select good practice mass transit systems, will have the necessary demonstrational impact for its scale up and to achieve more livable cities in Indonesia

The project will include of two components: (i) Component I: Institutional Development, Capacity Building and Technical Assistance activities to support the MoT and sub-national governments to roll out IMTP. It will also include project management and technical support to the two demonstration BRT projects; and (ii) Demonstration Mass Transit Systems in Selected Urban Areas. This component will support the implementation of safe, resilient, green and integrated mass transit projects in BBMA and Mebidang.

Procurement of contracts financed by the World Bank will be conducted through the procedures as specified in the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, as of November 2020 (Procurement Regulations), and is open to all eligible firms and individuals as defined in the Procurement Regulations. After project negotiations, the World Bank shall arrange the publication on its external website of the agreed initial procurement plan and all subsequent updates once it has provided a no objection. The agreed procurement plan should also be published on the MoT’s website.

Specific procurement notices for contracts subject to open international competitive procurement will be announced, as they become available, on the World Bank’s external website and MoT’s website, while for national open competitive procurement, SPN will be published in government e-procurement system.  Rated criteria will be required for evaluation of bids under international competitive procurement.

Interested eligible firms and individuals who would wish to be considered for the provision of goods, works, consulting services and non-consulting services for the above-mentioned project, or those requiring additional information, should contact the Borrower (the Implementing Agency, MoT) at the address below:

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

The Ministry of Finance has received a loan of $400M from the World Bank toward the cost of the Supporting Egypt’s Universal Health Insurance System Project, and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include consultancy aimed for Contracting with a consultancy firm for the provision of technical assistance to develop GAHAR's E-learning platform

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment are attached to this request for expressions of interest.

The “Supporting Egypt’s Universal Health Insurance System Project” now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services.

Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (company profile, brochures, experience in similar assignments, availability of appropriate skills and resources, ... etc.).

The requested qualifications are:

  • Experience:
    • At least 10 years of proven corporate experience in designing, developing, and deploying high-traffic, secure e-learning platforms (LMS).
    • Demonstrated experience in end-to-end instructional design for adult professional learners.
    • An extensive portfolio of high-quality multimedia production (videos, animations, graphic design) for educational or corporate training purposes.
  • Technical Capabilities:
    • Expertise in modern web development frameworks, database management, and cloud hosting.
    • Expertise in LMS standards (e.g., SCORM, xAPI) and e-commerce integration.
    •  
  • Proposed Team: The consultant must propose a team of key experts with the following minimum qualifications:
    • Project Manager: 8+ years experience managing complex IT and media projects.
    • Lead Instructional Designer: 8+ years experience in designing e-learning curricula for professional audiences.
    • Lead Developer / Tech Lead: 8+ years experience in full-stack development, specializing in LMS or large-scale web applications.
    • Lead Media Producer: 8+ years experience in professional video and animation production.

Note: Experience in medical or nursing education is not required. The consultant will be provided with all technical medical content

Where a consortium is proposed, one lead firm shall assume overall contractual accountability and shall clearly demonstrate how the expertise required across both pillars will be integrated through a unified project-management and quality-assurance approach.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” November 2020 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. 

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications, but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the QBS method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 10.00 am to 4.00 pm – Sunday to Thursday.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below by e-mail by 20 August, 2026

Supporting Egypt’s Universal Health Insurance System Project.

Attn: Yara Gamal –  Procurement Specialist.

                                 Term of Reference (TOR)

GAHAR E – Learning Academy

 

The Ministry of Finance has received a loan of $400M from the World Bank toward the cost of the Supporting Egypt’s Universal Health Insurance System Project, and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include design and execution of a comprehensive GAHAR E- Learning Academy platform with Content Development: Develop the content for the e-learning materials in alignment with the identified learning objectives.   for the General Authority for Healthcare Accreditation and Regulation –GAHAR through partnership with a reputable national organization.

  1. Background: The General Authority for Healthcare Accreditation and Regulation – GAHAR:

GAHAR was established under Law No. 2 for the year 2018 pertaining to the Universal Health Insurance system.

GAHAR is responsible of ensuring the quality of the healthcare services, and its continuous improvement; regulating the healthcare sector according to quality standards; accrediting the healthcare facilities according to these standards; and ensuring the sustainability of its implementation through regular monitoring., strongly rooted in its independence, which is stipulated by law. GAHAR is an independent authority Under the general and direct supervision of his Excellency, President of Egypt, Abdel-Fattah El-Sisi

GAHAR is mandated with the regulations, accreditation, rigorous monitoring and oversight of the healthcare facilities. it aims at attaining the best standardized quality for health throughout all healthcare facilities; Hospitals, pharmacies, clinics, and other healthcare facilities as defined in point 15 of article one in the law number two for year 2018. GAHAR's strategy has identified its mission in two main blocks: Excellence and Distinction, in pursuit to put Egypt on the edge of a new era for health care.

GAHAR handbooks are the guiding tool for healthcare facilities and surveyors, on GAHAR’ standards for accreditation and requirements for registration. To ensure its conformity with the best international practices, GAHAR applies to attain accreditation for its standards from the International Society for Quality in Healthcare –ISQua’. Till now, GAHAR has issued the following accreditation ‘handbooks: 

 

  • GAHAR handbook for Hospitals standards. (ISQua Accredited).
  • GAHAR handbook for Primary Health Care-PHC standards (ISQua Accredited).
  • GAHAR handbook for Clinical laboratories standards. (ISQua Accredited).
  • GAHAR handbook for Physical therapy accreditation standards. (ISQua Accredited).
  • GAHAR handbook for Ambulatory healthcare accreditation standards. (ISQua Accredited).
  •  GAHAR handbook for Radiology centers.  (ISQua Accredited).
  • GAHAR handbook for Mental health.  (ISQua Accredited).
  • GAHAR handbook for convalescent long – term healthcare and medical wellness accreditation standard.  (ISQua Accredited).
  • GAHAR handbook for National Guide for Medical Equipment for Hospital.

 

GAHAR Mission:

Commitment to ensuring the quality of healthcare services and its continuous improvement in the Arab Republic of Egypt, and affirming trust in its outcomes at national, regional, and international levels through issuance and development of internationally recognized national quality standards, supporting their implementation, accrediting healthcare facilities accordingly, and continuous monitoring; to achieve excellence and sustainability.

 

GAHAR vision:

To be a pioneering national authority, well-recognized regionally and internationally in ensuring the quality of healthcare services and its sustainability.

 

GAHAR training center:

In alignment with the General Authority for Healthcare Accreditation and Regulations (GAHAR) mission to promote a culture of quality, and in partnership with healthcare service providers in Egypt, GAHAR is committed to raising community awareness of patient safety, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within healthcare facilities, and preparing these facilities to implement healthcare quality standards to achieve accreditation and join the Universal Health Insurance System (UHIS). To support these efforts, GAHAR has established a training center accredited by the Central Agency for Organization and Administration and the Egyptian Health Council.

The center aims to empower professionals and facilities to:

  • Raise community awareness of patient safety.
  • Foster continuous improvement across health facilities.
  • Prepare facilities to implement quality standards, achieve accreditation, and transition smoothly into the UHIS framework.

GAHAR certification

GAHAR EGYCAP (Egyptian Certified Accreditation Professional)

  • A firstofitskind professional diploma accredited by the Egyptian Health Council and recognized national regionally
  • All the Applicants have to a receive a diploma in one of universities that signed a protocol with GAHAR , this diploma include 8 modules cover all the standards , then they receive a complementary course in GAHAR about primary health care standards , finally they have to pass GAHAR – EGY CAP certificate exam organized by GAHAR
  •  The reflection of EGY – Cap on upgrading leaders’ skills  in implementing GAHAR standards, patient-safety frameworks, and continuous quality improvement
  • The graduates will be able to work as accreditation professionals which is a new profession in healthcare field, these graduates will help healthcare facilities in their journey for accreditation

2. Project Goal And Objectives

2.1. Overall Goal

The overall goal of this assignment is to establish the "GAHAR E-Learning Academy," a high-quality, accessible, and sustainable digital education platform. The Academy will serve as the central hub for training healthcare professionals in Egypt on GAHAR's quality and accreditation standards, patient safety, and continuous improvement principles, supporting the national Universal Health Insurance System (UHIS).

2.2. Specific Objectives

The specific objectives of this consultancy are to:

  1. Design and Deploy a secure, scalable, and user-friendly Learning Management System (LMS) that functions seamlessly on desktop and mobile devices.
  2. Digitize and Produce GAHAR’s technical content into engaging, high-quality e-learning modules (including videos, animations, interactive case studies, and assessments).
  3. Build Capacity within GAHAR to manage, update, and scale the E-Learning Academy independently.
  4. Establish a Platform that serves as a sustainable model for continuous professional development (CPD) for the Egyptian healthcare workforce.

3. Target Audience

The primary target audiences for the E-Learning Academy include:

  • Healthcare Professionals: Doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and allied health professionals seeking CPD and certification (e.g., GAHAR EGYCAP).
  • Healthcare Administrators and Leaders: Facility managers and policymakers responsible for implementing quality improvement systems.
  • GAHAR Surveyors: Trainee and current surveyors requiring standardized training on accreditation processes.
  • Public Health Practitioners: Professionals aiming to enhance their competencies in healthcare management and quality.
  • Regional and International Learners: Professionals from other countries interested in GAHAR's accredited standards.

 

5. Scope Of Work

The consultant shall be responsible for all activities, personnel, and resources required to deliver the E-Learning Academy. The scope is divided into two main components.

GAHAR's Role in Content: For all content-related tasks, GAHAR will act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME). GAHAR will provide all technical source materials, accreditation handbooks, case study information, and raw data. The consultant is responsible for transforming this technical information into engaging e-learning experiences.

Component 1: E-Learning Platform Development

The consultant shall design, develop, test, and deploy a robust and scalable Learning Management System (LMS) with the following functional requirements:

  1. LMS Core: A secure system for user registration, authentication, and profile management. GAHAR shall hold full ownership rights to the platform's source code, database, and all associated intellectual property upon delivery. The consultant must deliver the full, unencrypted source code and provide a perpetual, royalty-free license for any third-party components used.
  2. Standards and Interoperability: The LMS must be fully compliant with international e-learning standards, specifically SCORM 1.2/2004, xAPI (Tin Can), and AICC. This ensures that all content produced is portable and prevents vendor lock-in, allowing GAHAR to migrate content to other systems if needed in the future.
  3. Course Management: An admin panel for GAHAR staff to easily create, upload, update, and manage courses and learning paths.
  4. Responsive Design: A fully responsive UI/UX (in both Arabic and English) that provides an optimal experience on desktops, tablets, and mobile smart phones.
  5. Assessment Engine: Ability to create diverse assessments (quizzes, summative exams, case-based evaluations) with features like question banks, randomization, and automated grading.
  6. Progress Tracking: Dashboards for learners to track their progress and for administrators to monitor user engagement and completion rates.
  7. Certification: Automated generation and delivery of certificates (e.g., PDF format) upon successful completion of a course or learning path.
  8. Interactive Tools: Features to enhance engagement, such as discussion forums, live chat capabilities, and scheduled QandA sessions with experts.
  9. E-commerce Integration: Integration with secure national payment gateways (e.g., Fawry, Paymob) and bank APIs to manage course fees.
  10. Analytics and Reporting: A comprehensive analytics dashboard for GAHAR to track key metrics (e.g., enrollment, user activity, completion rates, assessment scores).
  11. Security and Data Protection: Full compliance with Egypt’s personal data protection law (Law No. 151 of 2020) and international data security standards.
  12.  Infrastructure and Hosting Strategy:
  • Initial Deployment: The Consultant shall provide and manage a secure, high-availability cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, or a local Data Center) guaranteeing 99.9% uptime for the duration of the contract. The cost of this hosting must be clearly identified in the financial proposal.
  • Portability and Migration: To ensure long-term sustainability and data sovereignty, the platform must be containerized and architected to be infrastructure-agnostic. The Consultant must demonstrate that the entire system (code, database, and assets) can be technically and legally migrated to GAHAR’s own data center or government cloud in the future without loss of functionality or significant re-engineering.
  • Data Ownership: GAHAR retains full legal ownership of all data hosted on the platform.

Component 2: E-Learning Content Production

The consultant shall work with GAHAR SMEs to perform the instructional design and multimedia production for the curriculum.

  1. Instructional Design:
    • Review GAHAR's technical source materials (handbooks, lectures, EGYCAP content).
    • Develop detailed storyboards and scripts for all multimedia content, optimized for adult e-learning.
    • Design the pedagogical structure for each course, including learning objectives, module flow, and assessment strategy.
  2. Multimedia Production:
    • Produce all multimedia assets defined in the curriculum (see Section 6). This includes filming GAHAR experts, recording voice-overs, and designing all graphics and animations.
    • Edit all assets into high-quality, web-optimized formats (e.g., SCORM-compliant packages).
  3. Course Assembly:
    • Assemble all assets (videos, quizzes, readings) into cohesive course modules within the LMS.
    • Conduct internal Quality Assurance (QA) on all modules for technical functionality, accessibility, and instructional clarity.

7. Component 2: E-Learning Content Production - Overview:

Placeholder Curriculum: The consultant shall base their proposals on developing the following initial curriculum. The final list and topics will be confirmed during the project's inception phase.

  1. Modules: 8 modules covering all GAHAR standards.
  2. Media Assets (to be produced):
    • 12 Educational Videos: Professionally filmed and edited videos of GAHAR experts explaining key concepts (approx. 10-15 minutes each).
    • 6 Animation Videos: 2D/3D animated videos to explain complex processes or concepts (approx. 2-5 minutes each).
    • 6 Graphic Videos: Motion-graphic videos (approx. 2-5 minutes each).
  3. Assessments: Formative quizzes for each module and a final summative exam.

9. Platform technical specifications:

 1-Web site development , Technical  features ;

  1. Web & Mobile Architecture
  • Frontend Frameworks: Modern JavaScript component-based architectures (e.g., React.js, Angular, or Vue.js).
  • Mobile Application: Native (Swift/Kotlin) or high-performance Cross-platform framework (e.g., React Native, Flutter) ensuring 100% functionality on both iOS and Android devices.
  • Styling & UI: Modern CSS frameworks and UI libraries (e.g., Tailwind CSS, Material-UI, or Bootstrap 5+).
  1. Backend & Database
  • Server Framework: Scalable, high-performance server-side framework (e.g., Node.js with Express, Python Django, or .NET Core).
  • Database Management:
    • Primary (Relational): Robust SQL database for transactional data (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server).
    • Secondary (Unstructured): NoSQL database for logs, chats, and unstructured content (e.g., MongoDB).
  • Authentication & Security: Implementation of standard secure protocols including OAuth 2.0 and JWT (JSON Web Tokens) for secure, stateless user sessions.
  1. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI/ML)
  • Recommendation Engine: Implementation of ML libraries (e.g., TensorFlow.js, Scikit-learn) to provide personalized course recommendations based on user behavior.
  • Natural Language Processing (NLP): Integration with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI API, Azure OpenAI) to power language-based features. Note: Proposals using 3rd party APIs must clearly state ongoing subscription costs.
  1. Infrastructure & Hosting Responsibilities
  • Consultant Responsibility: The Consultant shall be fully responsible for providing, configuring, and paying for the cloud hosting infrastructure (e.g., AWS [EC2, S3, RDS], Google Cloud Platform, Azure, or a certified Data Center) for the entire duration of the contract. The financial proposal must explicitly include these hosting costs.
  • Performance Requirements: The infrastructure must be scalable (using containerization tools like Docker and orchestration via Kubernetes) and must guarantee 99.9% uptime.
  • Future Handover: To ensure sustainability, the system must be designed to be infrastructure-agnostic. The Consultant must include a comprehensive "Handover Plan" to migrate the entire platform (code, database, and data) to GAHAR’s own servers or a government cloud at the end of the contract term.
  1. Payment Integration
  • Payment Gateways: Secure integration with major national and international payment providers, specifically Fawry, Paymob, Apple Pay, and direct Bank API Integrations.
  1. Mobile App Advanced Features (Communication & Analytics)
  • Communication Services: Integration with services like Twilio or Firebase for SMS notifications, OTPs, and real-time messaging.
  • Analytics: Integration with Google Analytics (GA4) or Firebase Analytics for user tracking, with capability to export data to custom dashboards using Tableau or Power BI.
  1. AI-Powered Support (Chatbot)
  • AI Chatbot: An intelligent chatbot capable of handling common user inquiries and automatically redirecting complex issues to the appropriate support team or resources.

10. Project Deliverables and Timeline

The expected duration of the assignment shall be six (6.5) calendar months from the contract commencement date, equivalent to approximately 26 weeks. The implementation shall follow an accelerated approach, with platform development, instructional design and multimedia production undertaken through coordinated parallel workstreams.

procnotices.notice_text:
REPUBLIC OF GHANA

MINISTRY OF ROADS AND HIGHWAYS

DEPARTMENT OF FEEDER ROADS

 

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTING SERVICES)

Name of Project

Ghana Market Access and Connectivity Project (GMACP)-Project Preparatory Grant

Grant Number

IDA-E6230

Assignment Title

Engagement of a Gender and GBV/SEA-SH Specialist under Ghana Market Access and Connectivity Project (GMACP)

Procurement Plan Ref Number

GH-MRH-DFR-560054-CS-INDV

Country of Delivery

Ghana

  1. The Government of the Republic of Ghana has received a Grant from the World Bank towards the cost of the Project Preparation for the Ghana Market Access and Connectivity Project (GMACP), and intends to apply part of the proceeds for the Engagement of a Gender and GBV/SEA-SH Specialist.

The primary objective of this assignment is to recruit a Gender and GBV/SEA-SH Specialist (GBV Specialist) to provide technical leadership on gender equality, social inclusion, and Gender-Based Violence (GBV), including Sexual Exploitation and Abuse/Sexual Harassment (SEA-SH) risk management.

The consulting services (“the Services”) will ensure integration of gender equality and SEA-SH risk management into project design, implementation, and monitoring in line with Ghanaian legislation and the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework (ESF), particularly ESS1, ESS2, ESS4, ESS5, and ESS10. The Individual Consultant is required to undertake the following activities among others:

  1. Support the Agency Implementation Team (AIT) in the implementation of the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan (ESCP) and ensure effective integration of gender and SEA-SH considerations into all project preparatory activities, including Terms of Reference, Bidding Documents and Evaluation of Bids.
  2. Undertake technical review of the E&S instruments, feasibility studies and detailed designs to ensure effective integration of gender, GBV and SEA-SH risk mitigation measures within the GMACP preparatory activities and related implementation arrangements.
  3. Provide advisory support to the AIT on emerging gender and social risk issues during project preparation.
  4. Review the gender and SEA-SH aspects of all relevant E&S instruments and reports including ESIA, ESMF, RAP, LMP, SEP, GRM and SEA-SH-related instruments, to ensure compliance with the national regulatory requirements and WB ESS, and support disclosure of such instruments with the Safeguards Team.
  5. Support awareness creation, stakeholder sensitisation and information dissemination on the project-related gender, GBV and SEA-SH issues.

The estimated level of effort (professional person-months) is 1.27 person-months.

The implementation period for the assignment is expected to be 4 months from the commencement of the Assignment. The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained by sending an official request to the email addresses given below.

elormnyoagbe@icloud.com, cynthia.anane@mrh.gov.gh, efua.akwetea-mensah@dfr.gov.gh

 

The Ministry of Roads and Highways (MRH), acting through the Department of Feeder Roads, now invites eligible Individual Consultants to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Individual Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. Consultants are expected to submit a Curriculum Vitae (CV) with a description of experience in similar assignments, similar conditions, etc. Firms’ staff may express interest through the employing firm for the assignment and, under such situation, only the experience and qualifications of individuals shall be considered in the selection process.

 

2. Eligibility Requirement for the Assignment

The best qualified Individual Consultant to carry out the services will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant Selection (ICS) method set out in the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, the Seventh (7th) Edition, September 2025  (“the Regulations”). The criteria for selecting the Consultant are:  

(a) Minimum Mandatory Requirements (pass/fail):

  1. Certified copy of Academic Degree (Master’s Degree in Gender Studies, Social Sciences, Sociology, Development Studies, Law, Public Health, Psychology, Social Work, Rural Development, or a related field).
  2. Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience in gender analysis, gender mainstreaming, GBV/SEA-SH risk assessment, survivor-centered prevention and response programming, and gender-responsive GRMs, preferably within infrastructure or civil works projects.
  3. Evidence of experience in preparation and implementation of safeguards instruments such as GBV/ SEA-SH Action Plans, LMP and GRM frameworks under donor-funded projects in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) within the last 10 years.
