procnotices.notice_text:
UNIT KERJA PENGADAAN BARANG/JASA

KEMENTERIAN KELAUTAN DAN PERIKANAN

 

Undangan Untuk Memasukkan Pernyataan Berminat

 

 

Republik Indonesia

Nama Proyek: Ocean for Prosperity Project – LAUTRA

No. Loan: IBRD-94980

Nama Paket : Master Design Kampung LAUTRA Merah Putih

No. Referensi : ID-MMAF-559463-CS-CQS

 

Pemerintah Republik Indonesia telah menerima bantuan dana berupa pinjaman dari World Bank untuk membiayai Ocean for Prosperity Project – LAUTRA dan bermaksud untuk menggunakan sebagian dari dana pinjaman tersebut untuk membiayai Paket Kontrak Layanan Jasa Konsultan.

 

Untuk mendukung kebutuhan pengembangan kawasan ekonomi desa pesisir, perlu disusun Master Design Kampung LAUTRA Merah Putih sebagai pedoman konseptual pengembangan kawasan dan ekonomi Masyarakat pesisir yang memuat identitas kawasan, prinsip penataan, tipologi pengembangan, serta standar sarana dan prasarana yang menjadi penciri Kampung LAUTRA Merah Putih. Pengembangan kawasan diharapkan mampu menjaga fungsi ekosistem pesisir dan laut, memperhatikan daya dukung lingkungan, menghindari potensi dampak negatif masyarakat, serta mendorong keterlibatan dan manfaat inklusif bagi seluruh kelompok masyarakat

Kegiatan penyusunan Master Design ini diperkirakan akan dilaksanakan selama 2 (dua) bulan. Kerangka Acuan Kerja (KAK) yang lebih rinci untuk penugasan ini dapat ditemukan di situs web berikut: https://spseicb.lkpp.go.id/spseicb/.

 

Direktorat Jenderal Pengelolaan Kelautan Kementerian Kelautan dan Perikanan mengundang perusahaan konsultan yang memenuhi syarat untuk memasukkan pernyataan berminat untuk memberikan layanan jasa konsultan yang dibutuhkan. Perusahaan konsultan yang berminat harus memberikan informasi yang mendukung bahwa perusahaan konsultan yang bersangkutan memenuhi syarat untuk menjalankan layanan jasa tersebut di atas (misalnya: brosur/riwayat organisasi dan pengalaman dalam menjalankan layanan jasa konsultan dengan sifat dan kondisi yang sama, dan informasi lainnya yang relevan). Adapun kriteria untuk shortlist adalah: 

 

Penyedia Jasa yang akan melaksanakan pekerjaan ini diwajibkan memiliki kualifikasi sebagai berikut:

 

  1. Memiliki pengalaman dalam pekerjaan perencanaan arsitektur dan pengembangan kawasan dengan konsep pemanfaatan dan pengendalian ruang yang berkelanjutan (seperti: kerangka desain yang mengintegrasikan prinsip-prinsip Environmental dan Social Safeguard dan menggunakan pendekatan nature-based solutions). Pengalaman kerja yang dimaksud setidaknya berupa 3 paket pekerjaan yang sama/sejenis dalam kurun waktu 5 tahun terakhir.

 

  1. Diutamakan bagi Penyedia Jasa yang memiliki pengalaman pekerjaan (dengan spesifikasi sebagaimana dinyatakan di atas) di tingkat pedesaan/kelurahan.

 

Pekerjaan yang telah diselesaikan sesuai perjanjian oleh Penyedia Jasa harus dibuktikan dengan melampirkan bukti pendukung yang cukup (dokumen kontrak atau BAST), baik dalam posisi sebagai Penyedia Utama, anggota KSO, maupun Sub-Penyedia.

Selain itu, Penyedia Jasa juga diwajibkan untuk menyediakan Tenaga Ahli dan Tenaga Pendukung yang dibutuhkan, sebagaimana dinyatakan dalam KAK.

 

Perusahaan konsultan yang berminat harap memperhatikan prosedur dalam paragraph 3.14, 3.16 dan 3.17 dari The World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, Sixth Edition February 2025 (“Regulation”) tentang kebijakan Bank dunia mengenai konflik kepentingan.

 

Perusahaan konsultan diperkenankan untuk berasosiasi dengan perusahaan konsultan lain dalam bentuk Joint Venture atau sub-konsultan guna meningkatkan kualifikasinya.

 

Perusahaan konsultan akan diseleksi dengan metode Seleksi Berdasarkan Kualifikasi Konsultan/CQS (Consultant Qualification Selection) sesuai dengan Procurement Regulations.

 

Informasi tambahan dapat diminta pada alamat di bawah ini pada jam kerja, 09.00 sampai 16.00 WIB.

 

Surat Pernyataan Berminat beserta seluruh dokumen lampirannya harus disampaikan ke https://spseicb.lkpp.go.id/spseicb paling lambat pada tanggal 14 Agustus 2026 pukul 12.00 WIB

 

 

Jakarta, 31 Juli 2026

 

Kelompok Kerja (POKJA) Pemilihan Master Design Kampung LAUTRA Merah Putih

 

Kementerian Kelautan dan Perikanan

Jalan Medan Merdeka Timur No. 16 Jakarta Pusat, 10110

Email: pokmilwb@gmail.com

 

PROCUREMENT SERVICE UNIT MINISTRY OF MARINE AFFAIRS AND FISHERIES

 

 
  

 

 

 

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

 

 

 

Republic of Indonesia

 

Project Name: OCEANS FOR PROSPERITY-LAUTRA

Loan No.: IBRD-94980

 

Assignment Title: Master Design Kampung LAUTRA Merah Putih

 

Reference No.: ID-MMAF-559463-CS-CQS

 

The Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Oceans for Prosperity-Lautra, and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

 

To support the development needs of coastal village economic areas, it is necessary to prepare the **Master Design for Kampung LAUTRA Merah Putih** as a conceptual guideline for the development of coastal community areas and local economies. The Master Design will establish the area's identity, spatial planning principles, development typologies, and standards for infrastructure and public facilities that will serve as the defining characteristics of Kampung LAUTRA Merah Putih. The area development is expected to preserve the functions of coastal and marine ecosystems, take into account environmental carrying capacity, avoid potential adverse impacts on local communities, and promote inclusive participation and equitable benefits for all community groups.

 

The preparation of this Master Design is expected to be carried out over a period of **two (2) months**. A more detailed **Terms of Reference (TOR)** for this assignment can be found on the following website: [https://spseicb.lkpp.go.id/spseicb/]

 

The Directorate General of Marine Spatial Management of the Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries invites eligible consulting firms to submit **Expressions of Interest (EOIs)** for the provision of the required consulting services. Interested consulting firms shall provide information demonstrating that they possess the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the services described above (such as company brochures, organizational profiles, records of experience in carrying out similar consulting assignments under comparable conditions, and other relevant information).

 

The shortlist will be established based on the following criteria:

 

The consulting firm undertaking this assignment shall possess the following qualifications:

 

  1. Demonstrated experience in architectural planning and area development incorporating sustainable land use and spatial management concepts (such as design frameworks that integrate Environmental and Social Safeguards (E&S) principles and apply nature-based solutions (NbS) approaches). The consulting firm shall have successfully completed at least three (3) similar or comparable assignments within the last five (5) years.

Country: Republic of Mozambique

Name of Project: Mozambique Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration(SRSEI)

Grant No.: IDA-E0780

Assignment Title: Environmental, Health and Safety Specialist, PMU

Reference No. MZ-PMU-555677-CS-INDV

The Government of Mozambique represented by the Ministry of Transport and Logistics (MTL), has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Mozambique Safer Roads for Socio-Economic Integration Program and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) involves strengthening the PMU’s capacity to ensure environmental, social, health and safety (ESHS) sustainability of the operations under its oversight. The Specialist will support the identification, assessment, management, monitoring, and supervision of ESHS risks and impacts, and ensure that the preparation and implementation of projects are carried out in accordance with the applicable national legislation, the World Bank ESF or Ops, as applicable, GIIP, and with the requirements of other financing partners where relevant.

The Specialist should provide technical assistance to the UCP and the implementing entities (including Technical Units (UTs) / Project Implementation Units (UIPs= and sectoral agencies) in the design, implementation, monitoring, supervision and reporting of ESHS management instruments and measures. The Specialist should support the preparation, review and consolidation of technical reports on ESHS performance and compliance, ensuring that projects’ activities are implemented in accordance with applicable ESHS requirements.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be obtained at the following Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A5aZiM5RvGCpEd4rsDASYUAin1cRDQXN/view?usp=sharing

The Ministry of Transport and Logistics (MTL) now invites eligible individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Expressions of interest must include the following: (i) a curriculum vitae detailing qualifications, professional experience, and achievements in comparable assignments; (ii) a cover letter, not exceeding two pages, specifically addressing how the candidate meets each of the mandatory selection criteria. It is mandatory to specify the reference number and the job title, for the EOI to be considered.The criteria for selecting the Consultant are found in section 7 of the Terms of reference.

The attention of interested Consultants (including firms) is drawn to paragraph 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers September 2025 (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Further information can be obtained by sending an email to procurement.ucp@mtl.gov.mz during office hours 0900 to 1500 hours.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below only by e-mail by 14th August 2026.
